newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to meet N.Korean, U.S. diplomats on Monday.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to meet N.Korean, U.S. diplomats on Monday.

text.p: South Korea will attend a meeting with senior North Korean and U.S. diplomats on Monday in New York despite Pyongyang's repeated failure to give an answer to a peace proposal, a foreign ministry official said.
Kwon Tae-myon, a director at the ministry, told Reuters on Sunday that South Korea would agree to a North Korean suggestion that the three parties reschedule a meeting on Monday.
"I'm not sure if North Korea will turn up on Monday as they proposed, but our delegates will try again," Kwon said.

For the second straight day, North Korea failed on Saturday to resume scheduled discussions aimed at hearing Pyongyang's formal response to a year-old U.S.-South Korean proposal for four-nation peace talks, which also include China.
North Korean officials, saying they were awaiting directions from Pyongyang, proposed holding another meeting on Monday.
The four-nation talks are aimed at securing a lasting peace to replace a truce agreement that halted the 1950-53 Korean War but left the two Koreas technically at war.
